headline: Seagate launches FireCuda Forge hybrid SSD/hard-drive storage
summary: Seagate announced the FireCuda Forge, a hybrid external drive pairing SSD speed with higher-capacity hard-drive storage, available in 8TB or 20TB sizes, requiring users to supply their own NVMe SSD, powered by its new Alkemi intelligent storage platform.

claims.statement: Seagate announced the FireCuda Forge, a hybrid drive combining SSD speed with hard-drive capacity.

sources.quote: Seagate’s FireCuda Forge moves your data between a hard drive and SSD for better performance
Seagate announced a new external storage solution, called the FireCuda Forge, that combines the speed benefits of an SSD with the affordability of a higher-capacity hard drive.
Seagate resurrects hybrid storage: Hands-on with the FireCuda Forge – 8 or 20TB external hard drive requires you to bring your own NVMe SSD

claims.statement: The drive comes in 8TB or 20TB capacities and requires users to supply their own NVMe SSD.

sources.quote: a 8TB or 20TB hard drive that requires you to bring your own M.2 2280 SSD (ideally 1TB, with DRAM)

claims.statement: The Forge is powered by Seagate's new Alkemi intelligent storage platform, which relocates frequently used files to the faster drive.
